import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Complex Polynomial LinearMap FiniteDimensional Module Module.End
open scoped BigOperators

theorem intersection_is_unique_greatest_lower_bound {F V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Field F] [Module F V] {ι : Type*} (u : ι → Submodule F V) :
  ∃! U : Submodule F V,
    (⋂ i : ι, (u i).carrier) = (U : Set V) ∧
      ∀ W : Submodule F V, W ≤ U ↔ ∀ i : ι, W ≤ u i := by
  let U : Submodule F V := ⨅ i, u i
  have hU :
      (⋂ i : ι, (u i).carrier) = (U : Set V) ∧
        ∀ W : Submodule F V, W ≤ U ↔ ∀ i : ι, W ≤ u i := by
    constructor
    · ext x
      simp [U]
    · intro W
      constructor
      · intro h i
        change W ≤ (⨅ j : ι, u j) at h
        exact h.trans (iInf_le (fun j : ι => u j) i)
      · intro h
        change W ≤ (⨅ i : ι, u i)
        exact le_iInf h
  refine ⟨U, hU, ?_⟩
  intro V' hV'
  have hset : (V' : Set V) = (U : Set V) :=
    hV'.1.symm.trans hU.1
  apply Submodule.ext
  intro x
  change x ∈ (V' : Set V) ↔ x ∈ (U : Set V)
  rw [hset]

set_option autoImplicit false

open scoped BigOperators

theorem intersection_is_unique_greatest_lower_bound {F V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Field F] [Module F V] {ι : Type*} (u : ι → Submodule F V) :
  ∃! U : Submodule F V,
    (⋂ i : ι, (u i).carrier) = (U : Set V) ∧
      ∀ W : Submodule F V, W ≤ U ↔ ∀ i : ι, W ≤ u i := by
  let I : Submodule F V := ⨅ i, u i
  have hI : (⋂ i : ι, (u i).carrier) = (I : Set V) := by
    ext x
    simp [I]
  have hglb :
      ∀ W : Submodule F V, W ≤ I ↔ ∀ i : ι, W ≤ u i := by
    intro W
    simp [I]
  refine ⟨I, ⟨hI, hglb⟩, ?_⟩
  intro U hU
  apply Submodule.ext
  intro x
  have hset : (I : Set V) = (U : Set V) := hI.symm.trans hU.1
  exact Set.ext_iff.mp hset.symm x
